reading: Each region runs a row on its own server clock: us = US Central (CST/CDT), eu = Central European (CET/CEST). Daylight-saving rules written out by hand; end = start + the row's hours.
descriptions: Description text is not stored here. Each row has the SHA-256 of its client text (descriptionSha256) and, for the sentences data/forever.source.json quotes, their place in the text with whitespace collapsed and their SHA-256 (quoted). local/scripts/fixture-text.mjs --verify checks them against the client CSV.
